name: Question 10
problem:
A body of mass $5\,\text{kg}$ is moving in a straight line along the $x$-axis under the action of a single force $F,$ measured in Newtons.
At time $t$ seconds, the position of the body is given by $s(t)=t-4\sqrt{t}$ meters.
Find the expression for the force acting on the body at time $t.$
